Individual-QA gain cannot override whole-set QA loss; source audit likelihood/F1 controls rollback.
Negative QB cannot modify locked memory; absent QB reports null; insufficient QA stops before scorer initialization and COMPLETE.
Original import_source helper byte-identical; source_views helper differs only by removed zero-record exception.

limitations: The source-only pilot is not official LongMemEval accuracy, unseen benchmark generalization, Gemma transfer, or a novelty result.

Independent pipeline tests replace generation/retrieval with synthetic values; actual GPU compatibility remains to be exercised.
